description: Automatic reconnects for one viewer PageSession: a 10 s deadline on each socket's authenticated handshake, exponential backoff with a 60 s cap for transient failures, a stop on a refused signing key, a host's Retry-After as the least wait (capped at 60 s), a pause after six admission refusals in a row, and an outage report from the seventh transient failure in a row while retries continue. A tab hidden for five minutes parks (closes its socket on purpose, with no retry and no backoff) once the host has every edit, and reconnects when it shows or takes a local change. Runs against viewer/reconnect-machine.mjs in viewer/reconnect-machine.test.mjs.
